method: docker run --rm --entrypoint sh <image>, then for each PostgreSQL major under /usr/lib/postgresql: ls of share/postgresql/<major>/extension and lib/postgresql/<major>/lib, `postgres --version`, and default_version from timescaledb.control. Installable = install script AND shared object.
note: Generated by `make image-contents`. Records what each image can install, measured from its filesystem; overrules the registry labels. Nothing here says an upgrade between versions is supported.
